note: The iterated coefficient's own bound is not a field of `CoefIntegral` (only `ask` for the direct and `dual` for the difference, with both integrable), and the measurability is proved by continuity on the open set `V` and `measure_eval` rather than by the joint-measurability argument of Lemma 19.13.

lemma coefficient_joint {n:ℕ}{p:Fin n→Tree} (v:(fork n p).Leaf→S.Tag) (m:ℕ)(c:R.channels m)(D:(fork n p).Inner→ℕ):
    ∀ᶠ r:ℝ in 𝓝[>]0, ∀ (s:(fork n p|>.Inner)→ℝ),Tapered _ r 1 s → ∀ (μ:Measure K)(B:ℝ)(q:K→ℂ)(z:Envelope K (fork n p)), Integrable q μ→ (∫ i, ‖q i‖ ∂μ) ≤ B→ AEMeasurable z μ→
       (∀ᵐ i ∂μ, q i≠0→Accept r M η s (z i)) → CoefIntegral U R v m c D B ε s z q μ:=by
    let t:=fork n p; let g₁(x:Tree.Plot t):=Kernel.output U R x v c; let g₂(x:Tree.Plot t):=Kernel.chord U R x v c D; let g₀(x:Tree.Plot t):=g₁ x-g₂ x
    let V:=(Kernel.aperture U R t m D) ∩ {z| orbitMargin R.port m (Tree.profile z) (z|>anchor)}
    have he:IsOpen V:= Kernel.stencil U R .. |>.inter (Kernel.collar_open U R m)
    have hc:ContinuousOn g₁ V:= fun x hx=>(Kernel.output_smooth U R v c hx.2).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have h':ContinuousOn g₂ V:= fun x hx=>(Kernel.chord_smooth U R v c D hx.1).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hm:Measurable (V.indicator g₁):=by
       convert hc.measurable_piecewise (continuousOn_const (c:=(0:ℂ))) he.measurableSet using 1; ext i; by_cases h:i∈V <;> simp [Set.indicator,Set.piecewise,h,g₀]
    have hm':Measurable (V.indicator g₀):= by
       convert (hc.sub h').measurable_piecewise (continuousOn_const (c:=(0:ℂ))) he.measurableSet using 1; ext i; by_cases h:i∈V <;> simp [Set.indicator,Set.piecewise,h,g₀]
    filter_upwards [Limits.coe_power U R h hM hη hε v m c D] with r h s hx μ B f z hf hB hz hl
    let a:=bothToll (wages v) ε m D s; let b:= toll (wages v) ε m s
    have ht := hl.mono (q:=fun i=> f i≠0→ z i∈V) fun i hi hg=>⟨(h s (z i) (hi hg)).2.1,(h s (z i) (hi hg)).1⟩
    have hvs (g:Tree.Plot t→ℂ){c:ℝ}(hh:∀ᵐ i ∂μ,f i≠0→‖g (z i)‖ ≤ c)(hm:Measurable (V.indicator g))(hc:0≤c):= measure_eval f g z V c B hf hz ht hm hh hc hB
    obtain ⟨h₁,h₁'⟩:=hvs g₁ (hl.mono fun i hi hf=>h _ _ (hi hf) |>.2.2.1) hm (hx.pay_nonneg ..)
    obtain ⟨h₀,h₀'⟩:=hvs g₀ (hl.mono fun i hi hf=>h _ _ (hi hf) |>.2.2.2) hm' (hx.pay_both_nonneg ..)
    have h₂: (fun i=>f i*g₂ (z i))=(fun i=>f i*g₁ (z i)-f i*g₀ (z i)):=funext fun i=>by dsimp only [g₀]; rw [mul_sub,sub_sub_cancel]
    have hp: Integrable (fun i=>f i*g₂ (z i)) μ:= h₂ ▸ h₁.sub h₀
    refine ⟨h₁,hp,h₁',(?_ : ‖ (∫ i, f i*g₁ (z i) ∂μ) - (∫ i, f i*g₂ (z i) ∂μ)‖ ≤ _)⟩
    rw [← integral_sub h₁ hp]; exact (show (fun i=> f i * g₀ (z i)) = (fun i=> f i * g₁ (z i) - f i * g₂ (z i)) from funext (fun i=>mul_sub ..)) ▸ h₀'

proof_context.conclusion: For `Accept`ed geometries almost everywhere the weighted direct and iterated coefficients are integrable, with bounds `B*toll` and `B*bothToll` for the integral and the difference (`CoefIntegral`), thresholds taken from `coe_power`.

lemma all_weighted : ∀ᶠ r:ℝ in 𝓝[>]0,∀ (s:((fork n f).Inner→ℝ))(μ:Measure K)(B:ℝ)(u:K→ℂ), Tapered (fork n f) r 1 s → Integrable u μ→ (∫ i, ‖u i‖ ∂μ) ≤ B →
    ∀ (z:Tree.Envelope K (fork n f))(y:K→J→E4), AEMeasurable z μ → AEMeasurable y μ → (∀ᵐ i ∂μ,u i≠0→Accept r M η s (z i) ∧ Buffer (z i) (y i) δ) →
    let estimate:=JointEstimate U R m (voices v) (voices w) (B *(Tree.toll (wages v) ε (m+1:ℝ) s) ) μ u (TestedProfile (fork n f) z y)
    (∀ t:K→U.α.space.X, AEMeasurable t μ →estimate (.some ∘ t)) ∧ estimate (fun _=>none):=by
    filter_upwards [raw_wave U R h hM hη hε v w hδ,Limits.tested_power U R h hM hη hδ hε v w m] with r ht he s μ B u hs hf hq z y hz hy H
    let t:=fork n f; let p:K→ Loc t.Leaf J:= TestedProfile t z y
    have hp:AEMeasurable p μ:= ((Kernel.plot_smooth (J:=J) (t:=t)).continuous.measurable).comp_aemeasurable (hz.prodMk hy)
    let b (m:ℝ):= Tree.toll (wages v) ε m s
    let guard:= guardZone (I:=t.Leaf) (J:=J) U R m
    have test {Y:Type}[MeasurableSpace Y] (g:Y→Viewers U)
         (hx:Measurable (fun z:Loc t.Leaf J × Y=> guard.indicator (fun t=> formula U R t.1 t.2.1 (voices v) t.2.2 (voices w) m (g z.2)) z.1))
         (hx':Measurable (fun z:Loc t.Leaf J × Y=> guard.indicator (fun t=> whole (spectator U (g z.2)) t.1 (voices v) t.2.2 (voices w)) z.1))
         (phase:K→Y)(h:AEMeasurable phase μ): JointEstimate U R m (voices v) (voices w) (B*b (m+1)) μ u p (g ∘ phase):=by
           apply price_measurable U R _ _ p phase g m (c:=b (m+1)) (A:=b 0) (B:=B) hx hx' hp h hf hq _ _ _ (hs.pay_nonneg ..)
           · exact H.mono fun i hi hw=>(he s (z i) (y i) (hi hw).1 (hi hw).2).1
           · exact H.mono fun i hi hw=>(he s (z i) (y i) (hi hw).1 (hi hw).2).2.2 (g (phase i))
           exact H.mono fun i hi hw=>(ht s (z i) (y i) (hi hw).1 (hi hw).2) (g (phase i))
    exact ⟨fun y hy=>test (Y:=U.α.space.X) some (mixed_meas ..) (clip_mixed ..) y hy, test (Y:=Unit) (fun _=>none) ((indicator_meas ..).comp measurable_fst) ((clip_whole ..).comp measurable_fst) (fun _=>()) aemeasurable_const⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The weighted tested estimate has bound `B * toll (m+1)` for every a.e.-measurable phase map and for the mixed state.
